highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ships a focused wave of managed-code performance improvements.
highlights_body: Hot paths for SKColor conversion, hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reading move to zero-allocation managed C#. HarfBuzzSharp buffer encoding becomes allocation-free via pooled UTF-8. WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11. A CPU raster regression from the Skia legacy shader context removal is also corrected.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, bringing upstream stability fixes from Google's chrome/m151 branch.
SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was inadvertently dropped; restoring it fixes a CPU raster rendering regression affecting non-GPU drawing paths.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse and TryParse gain ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and an optimized hex parser, removing intermediate allocations on hot parse paths.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: The overload that accepts an SKData and an SKRectI crop rect leaked a native reference; it is now correctly released.
Pre-built native WASM libraries compiled with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the new exnref exception-handling model are included for .NET 11 WASM targets.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition and contributed Emscripten WASM library updates for .NET 11

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 delivered the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, the CPU raster regression fix, the m151 engine sync, and a native resource leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 shipped the performance wave: allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy SKShaper glyph reading, SKFourByteTag and HarfBuzz Tag parse micro-optimizations, and another round of m151 upstream patches.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line by advancing the Skia submodule to milestone m151.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes to HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1, making Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removing the per-call char[4] heap allocation in Tag.Parse.
